Kualitas   tidur dan kebiasaan   makan bisa menjadi salah satu  faktor yang dapat meningkatkan risiko diabetes mahasiswa di kemudian hari. penelitian ini adalah untuk menganalisis hubungan antara kualitas tidur dan kebiasaan  makan risiko terjadinya diabetes pada mahasiswa Metode: Penelitian menggunakan desain deksriptif analitik   dengan   pendekatan cross-sectional Populasi   penelitian ini   adalah   mahasiswa   Universitas Airlangga_ Besar   sampel sebanyak 116 responden dengan teknik   pengambilan   sampel menggunakan purposive sampling  Variabel independent dalam penelitian ini adalah kualitas tidur dan kebiasaan makan dan dihubungkan dengan variabel dependen risiko diabetes. Pengukuran kualitas tidur menggunakan Pinshurgh Sleep Quality Index, kebiasaan makan   menggunakan Deulch   Eating Behaviour Questionnaire; dan Finnish Diahetes Risk Score untuk mengukur risiko diabetes_ Analisis meng ggunakan uji Spearmen Rho dengan tingkat   ssignifikan <0,05. Hasil: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan ada hubungan antara kualitas tidur dengan risiko diabetes (p-0,005; r0,259) dan ada hubungan antara kebiasaan makan dengan risiko diabetes (p0,02; 10,215) pada mahasiswa. Diskusi: Studi selanjutnya perlu mencakup analisis mendalam terhadap faktor-faktor seperti beban akademik non-akademik, preferensi makanan, dan   riwayat   konsums obat-obatan   yang  mungkin berpengaruh kualitas tidur; kebiasaan makan, dan risiko diabetes pada mahasiswa Kata Kunci: Risiko Diabetes; Kualitas Tidur; Kebiasaan Makan, Mahasiswa SKRIPSI IIUBUNGAN KUALITAS TIDUR. Sleep quality and eating habits can be one of the factors that can increase the risk of diabetes college students in the future. The purpose of this study was to analyze the relationship between sleep quality and eating habits with the risk of diabetes in college students. Method This study used descriptive design   with Ciuss sectional   approach The population of this study were students of Airlangga University. The sample size was 116   respondents vith sampling technique purposive   sampling: The independent variables in this study were quality and habits and were related the dependent variable of diabetes risk. Measurement of quality using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index, habits the Deutch Behavior Questionnaire, and the Finnish Diabetes Risk Score to measure the risk of diabetes. Analysis using the Spearmen Rho test with significance level <0.05 Results The results of the study showed that there was relationship between quality and the risk of diabetes 0.005; r0.2597 and there was relationship between eating habits and the risk of diabetes (p-0.02; r0.215) in college students . Discussion: Further studies need to include an in-depth analysis of factors such as academic non-academic burden, food preferences, and of drug use that may affect sleep quality, eating habits; and the risk of diabetes in college students. The low knowledge; attitudes; and skills of children in asthma management lead to inappropriate behavior when dealing with asthma attacks in the school envıronment This study aims to analyze the effect of role play with monopoly media on knowledge,   attitudes; and actions of junior high school children Methods: This study used a quasy experimental design with pre-post test control group design. The research sample amounted to 70 VIII grade students in JHS 3 Tuban and JHS 5 Tuban who were divided into 35 treatment group respondents and 35 control group   respondents through   purposive   sampling   technique: The independent  variable is role play intervention with monopoly media, while the dependent variable includes knowledge, attitudes; and asthma management actions The intervention was given twice with duration of + 60 minutes each meeting. The research instrumens were knowledge and attitude questionnaires and action observation sheets that had been tested for validity and reliability. Data analysis used Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test and Mann Whitney U Test. Results: Wilcoxon test showed a significant increase in the treatment group on knowledge (p=0.000), attitude (p=0.000), and action (p=0.000), after the intervention. Meanwhile, the control group found no significant difference between the pre-test and post-test results. The Mann Whitney U Test results showed a significant difference between the treatment group and the control group at the post-test stage for knowledge; attitude, and action. Discussion:  Role play intervention with monopoly media proved to be effective in improving knowledge, positive attitudes; and actions of junior high school children in asthma management. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis hubungan kekuatan otot kaki dan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia di Panti Werdha  Surabaya. Metode Metode yang digunakan desain korelasional dengan pendekatan cross sectional. Besar populasi penelitian 174 responden lansia di UPTD Griya Werdha Surabaya dengan besar sampel yang diteliti sebanyak 122 responden lansia yang didapatkan dengan purposive sampling. Variabel Independen penelitian ini adalah Kekuatan Otot Kaki dan Keseimbangan Tubuh. Variabel dependen adalah Risiko Jatuh lansia. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan lembar observasi dengan instrumen Chair Stand Test; Berg Balance Scale; dan Timed Up and Go   Test; serta   dianalisis   menggunakan  uji Spearman Rank   dengan  nilai signifikan p < 0,05. Hasil hasil analisis kekuatan otot kaki dengan risiko jatuh lansia didapatkan (p< 0,001 ,r =0,971) dan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia di dapatkan (p= 0,002 0,273). Kesimpulan Kekuatan otot kaki   memiliki   hubungan  negatif  dengan risiko jatuh lansia   menandakan adanya hubungan yang tidak searah Diikuti dengan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia juga didapatkan hubungan negatif yang tidak searah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis hubungan kekuatan otot kaki dan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia di Panti Werdha  Surabaya. Metode Metode yang digunakan desain korelasional dengan pendekatan cross sectional. Besar populasi penelitian 174 responden lansia di UPTD Griya Werdha Surabaya dengan besar sampel yang diteliti sebanyak 122 responden lansia yang didapatkan dengan purposive sampling. Variabel Independen penelitian ini adalah Kekuatan Otot Kaki dan Keseimbangan Tubuh. Variabel dependen adalah Risiko Jatuh lansia. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan lembar observasi dengan instrumen Chair Stand Test; Berg Balance Scale; dan Timed Up and Go   Test; serta   dianalisis   menggunakan  uji Spearman Rank   dengan  nilai signifikan p < 0,05. Hasil hasil analisis kekuatan otot kaki dengan risiko jatuh lansia didapatkan (p< 0,001 ,r =0,971) dan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia di dapatkan (p= 0,002 0,273). Kesimpulan Kekuatan otot kaki   memiliki   hubungan  negatif  dengan risiko jatuh lansia   menandakan adanya hubungan yang tidak searah Diikuti dengan keseimbangan tubuh dengan risiko jatuh pada lansia juga didapatkan hubungan negatif yang tidak searah. Method: The method used is a correlational design with cross-sectional  approach. The study population was 174 elderly respondents at the UPTD Griya Werdha Surabaya with a sample size of 122 elderly respondents obtained by purposive sampling: The independent variables of this study are Muscle Strength and Body Balance. The dependent variable is the Risk of Falling in the elderly: Data were collected using observation sheets the Chair Stand Test, Balance Scale; and Timed Up and Go Test instruments; and analyzed using the Spearman Rank test with a significant value ofp 05. Results: The results of the analysis of leg muscle strength with the risk of falling in the elderly were obtained (p 0.001, r = 0.971) and body balance with the risk of falling in the elderly were obtained (p = 0.002,r = 0.273). Conclusion: Leg muscle strength is negatively associated with fall risk in the elderly; indicating a unidirectional relationship . Low knowledge and education levels regarding the prevention   of diabetes   mellitus   are major   contributing factors   to this   disease Adolescents' unhealthy lifestyles, such as high sugar consumption; lack of physical activity; and low awareness  of health further  increase the risk of developing diabetes mellitus at young age. This study aims to analyze the effect of providing Doratoon animation video on   adolescents'  knowledge   and attitudes toward diabetes mellitus prevention. Method: The design of this study is pre-experimental one-group pre-post test design The sample in this  study consisted of grade X students from SMAN 19 Surabaya. The sampling technique used was purposive sampling; with 32 respondents selected The independent variable in this study was health   education   through   the Doratoon   animation   video;  while the   dependent variables were knowledge and attitudes . Data were collected knowledge and attitude questionnaires and then analyzed using the Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test with significance value of p 0.005. Results: This study shows that there is an effect of health education through the Doratoon animation video on adolescents' knowledge  and attitudes   toward diabetes   mellitus   prevention, with significance values for knowledge (p 0.000) and attitudes (p - 0.000) Conclusion: This study shows that providing health education through the Doratoon animation video has effect on   adolescents'   knowledge and attitudes toward diabetes   mellitus prevention. The Doratoon   animation video can be used learning media to increase adolescents' knowledge and attitudes toward diabetes mellitus prevention. Method: The design of this study is pre-experimental one-group pre-post test design The sample in this  study consisted of grade X students from SMAN 19 Surabaya. The Doratoon   animation video can be used learning media to increase adolescents' knowledge and attitudes toward diabetes mellitus prevention. ACHMAD HAIDAR ULINUHA sehingga IR - PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK PREDIKTOR PILIHAN KARIR ALUMNI KEPERAWATAN YANG BEKERJA DI BIDANG NON-KEPERAWATAN Oleh Achmad Haidar Ulinuha Pendahuluan: Profesi keperawatan perlu mempertahankan sumber daya keperawatan untuk menjadi perawat profesional. Oleh sebab itu perlu diketahui prediktor pilihan karir alumni di non-keperawatan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis   prediktor   yang  berhubungan   dengan   pilihan karir alumni keperawatan  yang bekerja di bidang non-keperawatan. Metode:   Penelitian ini menggunakan desain potong lintang (cross-sectional) . Data diperoleh dari Tracer Study Alumni Fakultas Keperawatan Universitas Airlangga. Sebanyak 101 lulusan dipilih   menggunakan purposive sampling Variabel yang dianalisis dalam penelitian ini adalah usia; jenis kelamin; tempat tinggal, program; gaji, Indeks Prestasi Kumulatif (IPK) sarjana; dan IPK ners. Instrumen penelitian menggunakan kuisioner Tracer   Study Alumni Fakultas   Keperawatan Universitas   Airlangga. Analisis menggunakan chi-square dan regresi logistik dengan aplikasi SPSS versi 26.0. Hasil: Sebesar 26,79 alumni keperawatan memilih bekerja di non - keperawatan.  Ada hubungan antara program yang diambil  dengan pilihan karir alumni keperawatan yang bekerja di non-keperawatan_ Tetapi tidak ada prediktor   yang berpengaruh   terhadap   pilihan karir   alumni keperawatan yang bekerja   di non-keperawatan. Therefore, it is necessary to know the predictors of alumni's career choice in the non-nursing field. This study aims to analyze the predictors associated with the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Methods: This study used cross-sectional design. The data were obtained from the Tracer Study Alumni of the Faculty of Nursing, Universitas Airlangga. A total of 101 graduates were selected using purposive sampling. The variables analyzed in this study were age, gender; place of residence, program; salary, undergraduate Grade Point Average (GPA), and nurses GPA The research instrument used Tracer   Study Alumni   questionnaire   from   the Faculty of   Nursing, Universitas Airlangga. Analysis chi-square   and logistic regression with SPSS  version 26.0. Results: 26.79 of nursing alumni choose to work in non-nursing fields. There is relationship between the programs taken and the career choices of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. But no predictor affects the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Conclusions: There is no predictor that affects the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Not all nursing alumni choose a career in nursing. ACHMAD HAIDAR ULINUHA sehingga IR - PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK PREDIKTOR PILIHAN KARIR ALUMNI KEPERAWATAN YANG BEKERJA DI BIDANG NON-KEPERAWATAN Oleh Achmad Haidar Ulinuha Pendahuluan: Profesi keperawatan perlu mempertahankan sumber daya keperawatan untuk menjadi perawat profesional. Oleh sebab itu perlu diketahui prediktor pilihan karir alumni di non-keperawatan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis   prediktor   yang  berhubungan   dengan   pilihan karir alumni keperawatan  yang bekerja di bidang non-keperawatan. Metode:   Penelitian ini menggunakan desain potong lintang (cross-sectional) . Data diperoleh dari Tracer Study Alumni Fakultas Keperawatan Universitas Airlangga. Sebanyak 101 lulusan dipilih   menggunakan purposive sampling Variabel yang dianalisis dalam penelitian ini adalah usia; jenis kelamin; tempat tinggal, program; gaji, Indeks Prestasi Kumulatif (IPK) sarjana; dan IPK ners. Instrumen penelitian menggunakan kuisioner Tracer   Study Alumni Fakultas   Keperawatan Universitas   Airlangga. Analisis menggunakan chi-square dan regresi logistik dengan aplikasi SPSS versi 26.0. Hasil: Sebesar 26,79 alumni keperawatan memilih bekerja di non - keperawatan.  Ada hubungan antara program yang diambil  dengan pilihan karir alumni keperawatan yang bekerja di non-keperawatan_ Tetapi tidak ada prediktor   yang berpengaruh   terhadap   pilihan karir   alumni keperawatan yang bekerja   di non-keperawatan. Kesimpulan: Tidak ada   prediktor yang berpengaruh terhadap pilihan karir alumni keperawatan yang bekerja di bidang non - keperawatan. Alumni   keperawatan tidak semuanya memilih karir di   bidang keperawatan.   Program yang  ditawarkan baik   reguler   ataupun alih jenis yakni perlunya perhatian khusus melalui kegiatan yang dapat meningkatkan rasa minat dan bangga terhadap profesi keperawatan; sehingga dapat mempertahankan alumni bekerja sebagai perawat. Therefore, it is necessary to know the predictors of alumni's career choice in the non-nursing field. This study aims to analyze the predictors associated with the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Methods: This study used cross-sectional design. The data were obtained from the Tracer Study Alumni of the Faculty of Nursing, Universitas Airlangga. A total of 101 graduates were selected using purposive sampling. The variables analyzed in this study were age, gender; place of residence, program; salary, undergraduate Grade Point Average (GPA), and nurses GPA The research instrument used Tracer   Study Alumni   questionnaire   from   the Faculty of   Nursing, Universitas Airlangga. Analysis chi-square   and logistic regression with SPSS  version 26.0. Results: 26.79 of nursing alumni choose to work in non-nursing fields. There is relationship between the programs taken and the career choices of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. But no predictor affects the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Conclusions: There is no predictor that affects the career choice of nursing alumni who work in non-nursing fields. Not all nursing alumni choose a career in nursing. ACHMAD YUSKIR R R IR - PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK HUBUNGAN ANTARA OTONOMI KESEHATAN DAN PEMANFAATAN PELAYANAN KESEHATAN IBU DENGAN PERAWATAN KESEHATAN BALITA DI INDONESIA Oleh: Achmad Yuskir Rizal Rosuli Pendahuluan: Perawatan kesehatan balita merupakan proses perawatan kesehatan yang dilakukan untuk memberikan upaya pencegahan (imunisasi) dan perawatan balita sakit (diare, ISPA, demam) Proses  perawatan kesehatan balita ada peran ibu didalamnya otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan  ibu. Penelitian ini bertujuan  menganalisis   hubungan antara otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu perawatan kesehatan balita di Indonesia. Metode: Desain penelitian ini adalah analitik-cross sectional dengan   menggunakan data dari Survei Demografi dan Kesehatan Indonesia (SDKI) tahun 2017. Variabel independen otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan   ibu, serta variabel dependen status imunisasi dan perawatan balita sakit. Sampel 3,708 ibu yang memiliki anak balita dilibatkan dalam analisis . Kuesioner yang digunakan adalah kuesioner wanita usia subur SDKI 2017. Analisis menggunakan chi-square dan regresi logistik mengunakan STATA versi 16 MP Windows Hasil: Hasil   penelitian yang berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita di Indonesia adalah otonomi kesehatan ibu (OR=2.92; CI959:1.31-6.54) dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu (OR=-3.97; CI95%: 2.83-5.56). Variabel yang berhubungan perawatan balita sakit di Indonesia adalah pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu (OR=1.78; CI959: 1.27-2.50). Kesimpulan: Otonomi kesehatan ibu   hanya berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita di Indonesia, sedangkan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita dan perawatan balita sakit di Indonesia. Penelitian ini memberikan opsi  kebijakan peningkatan perawatan kesehatan balita dengan meningkatkan otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu. Kata Kunci: morbiditas balita, otonomi kesehatan ibu, perawatan kesehatan ibu, status imunisasi, survei demografi dan kesehatan Indonesia. The process of health care for children under five has a mother's role in it, namely health autonomy and the use of maternal health services. This study aims to analyze the   relationship between health   autonomy and the utilization of maternal  health services with health care for children under five in Indonesia. Methods: The design of this study was analytic-cross sectional data from the Indonesian Demographic and Health Survey (IDHS) in 2017. The independent variables were health autonomy and utilization of maternal health services, and the dependent   variable was immunization status   and care for sick children sample of  3,708 mothers who had children under  five were included in the analysis The questionnaire used was the 2017 IDHS for women of childbearing age. The analysis used   chi-square and   logistic   regression   using the 16 MP Windows version of STATA Results: The results of the study related to the immunization status   of children under five in Indonesia were maternal health autonomy (OR=2.92; 959 CI:1.31-6.54) and utilization of maternal health services (OR=3.97; 959 CI: 2.83-5.56). The variable related to the care of sick under-five children in Indonesia is the utilization of maternal health   services (OR=1.78; 959 CI: 1.27-2.50). Conclusion:  Maternal health autonomy is only related to the immunization status of children under five in Indonesia, while the utilization of maternal health services is related to the immunization status and care of sick children under five in Indonesia. This study provides policy options for improving children under five health care by increasing health autonomy and utilization of maternal health services . ACHMAD YUSKIR R R IR - PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK HUBUNGAN ANTARA OTONOMI KESEHATAN DAN PEMANFAATAN PELAYANAN KESEHATAN IBU DENGAN PERAWATAN KESEHATAN BALITA DI INDONESIA Oleh: Achmad Yuskir Rizal Rosuli Pendahuluan: Perawatan kesehatan balita merupakan proses perawatan kesehatan yang dilakukan untuk memberikan upaya pencegahan (imunisasi) dan perawatan balita sakit (diare, ISPA, demam) Proses  perawatan kesehatan balita ada peran ibu didalamnya otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan  ibu. Penelitian ini bertujuan  menganalisis   hubungan antara otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu perawatan kesehatan balita di Indonesia. Metode: Desain penelitian ini adalah analitik-cross sectional dengan   menggunakan data dari Survei Demografi dan Kesehatan Indonesia (SDKI) tahun 2017. Variabel independen otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan   ibu, serta variabel dependen status imunisasi dan perawatan balita sakit. Sampel 3,708 ibu yang memiliki anak balita dilibatkan dalam analisis . Kuesioner yang digunakan adalah kuesioner wanita usia subur SDKI 2017. Analisis menggunakan chi-square dan regresi logistik mengunakan STATA versi 16 MP Windows Hasil: Hasil   penelitian yang berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita di Indonesia adalah otonomi kesehatan ibu (OR=2.92; CI959:1.31-6.54) dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu (OR=-3.97; CI95%: 2.83-5.56). Variabel yang berhubungan perawatan balita sakit di Indonesia adalah pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu (OR=1.78; CI959: 1.27-2.50). Kesimpulan: Otonomi kesehatan ibu   hanya berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita di Indonesia, sedangkan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu berhubungan dengan status imunisasi balita dan perawatan balita sakit di Indonesia. Penelitian ini memberikan opsi  kebijakan peningkatan perawatan kesehatan balita dengan meningkatkan otonomi kesehatan dan pemanfaatan pelayanan kesehatan ibu. Kata Kunci: morbiditas balita, otonomi kesehatan ibu, perawatan kesehatan ibu, status imunisasi, survei demografi dan kesehatan Indonesia. The process of health care for children under five has a mother's role in it, namely health autonomy and the use of maternal health services. This study aims to analyze the   relationship between health   autonomy and the utilization of maternal  health services with health care for children under five in Indonesia. Methods: The design of this study was analytic-cross sectional data from the Indonesian Demographic and Health Survey (IDHS) in 2017. The independent variables were health autonomy and utilization of maternal health services, and the dependent   variable was immunization status   and care for sick children sample of  3,708 mothers who had children under  five were included in the analysis The questionnaire used was the 2017 IDHS for women of childbearing age. The analysis used   chi-square and   logistic   regression   using the 16 MP Windows version of STATA Results: The results of the study related to the immunization status   of children under five in Indonesia were maternal health autonomy (OR=2.92; 959 CI:1.31-6.54) and utilization of maternal health services (OR=3.97; 959 CI: 2.83-5.56). The variable related to the care of sick under-five children in Indonesia is the utilization of maternal health   services (OR=1.78; 959 CI: 1.27-2.50). Conclusion:  Maternal health autonomy is only related to the immunization status of children under five in Indonesia, while the utilization of maternal health services is related to the immunization status and care of sick children under five in Indonesia. This study provides policy options for improving children under five health care by increasing health autonomy and utilization of maternal health services . Surabaya, 30 Januari 2026 Penulis, Quu de Capri Surya Saputra 132221111 XI SKRIPSI HUBUNGAN PENGETAHUAN SISWA ADE CAPRI S.S mari dengan IR PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK HUBUNGAN PENGETAHUAN SISWA TENTANG MAKAN BERGIZI GRATIS (MBG) DENGAN SISA MAKANAN (FOOD WASTE) PADA SISWA DI SMA NEGERI 3 PAMEKASAN Penelitian Cross Sectional Ade Capri Surya Saputra Fakultas Keperawatan Universitas Airlangga ade caprisurya-2022@fkpunairac id Pendahuluan: Sisa makanan (food waste) di sekolah merupakan masalah kesehatan lingkungan yang berdampak pada sanitasi, efisiensi program gizi; serta pemborosan sumber daya dan berpotensi menjadi media berkembangnya vektor penyakit; sehingga dapat menghambat efektivitas Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) dalam meningkatkan status gizi, kesehatan; dan konsentrasi belajar siswa; oleh karena itu penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan antara pengetahuan siswa tentang tujuan MBG, gizi seimbang; dan dampak food waste dengan kejadian sisa makanan di sekolah. Metode: Penelitian ini menggunakan Desain korelasional dengan pendekatan cross-sectional. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 220 responden dari total populasi 360 siswa kelas XI yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Variabel independen adalah pengetahuan siswa tentang Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) sedangkan variabel dependen adalah sisa makanan (food waste). Instrumen yang digunakan berupa kuesioner pengetahuan tentang MBG dan kuesioner sisa makanan (food waste) Analisis data dilakukan secara univariat dan bivariat untuk menganalisis hubungan antara pengetahuan siswa dan kejadian food waste. Hasil: Analisis yang dilakukan  menunjukkan hasil tidak  ada hubungan antara pengetahuan siswa dengan sisa makanan (food waste) (p = 0,108;r = -0,109. Pembahasan: Berdasarkan Food waste Behavior Model,  pengetahuan siswa berperan sebagai faktor kognitif awal; namun perilaku food waste terbentuk melalui pengaruh kebiasaan dan konteks lingkungan. Preferensi rasa, kualitas dan tampilan makanan; pengaruh sosial kebiasaan makan keluarga; serta porsi dan penyajian menu lebih menentukan praktik menyisakan makanan. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa pengetahuan  saja belum cukup mengubah perilaku; sehingga pengurangan food waste memerlukan perbaikan kualitas menu; penyesuaian serta pembentukan budaya menghargai makanan di sekolah. Kata kunci:   Pengetahuan Gizi, Makan   Bergizi   Gratis   (MBG), Food Waste, Perilaku Konsumsi, Siswa SMA xii SKRIPSI HUBUNGAN PENGETAHUAN SISWA ADE CAPRI S.S porsi, IR PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRACT THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN STUDENTS' KNOWLEDGE ABOUT FREE NUTRITIONAL MEALS (MBG) AND FOOD WASTE IN PUBLIC SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL 3 PAMEKASAN Cross-Sectional Research Ade Capri Surya Saputra Faculty 0f Nursing, Airlangga University adecapri surya-2022@fkpunairac id Introduction: Food waste in schools is an environmental  health problem that impacts   sanitation; the efficiency of nutrition   programs, as well as waste of resources and has the potential to become a medium for the development of disease vectors; s0 that it can hinder the effectiveness of the Free Nutritional Meal Program (MBG) in improving the nutritional status, health, and concentration of students" learning,  therefore this study aims to analyze the relationship between students ~ knowledge about the objectives of MBG, balanced nutrition; and the impact of food waste with the incidence of food waste in schools. Method: This study used correlational   design with cross-sectional   approach. The research amounted to 220 respondents from a total population of 360 grade XI students selected   using purposive   sampling   technique. The   independent   variable is students' knowledge about the Free Nutritional Meal Program (MBG), while the dependent   variable is food waste. The instruments used were knowledge questionnaire about MBG and food waste questionnaire. Data analysis was carried out   univariately   and   bivariately to analyze  the relationship between students' knowledge and the incidence of food waste. Results: The analysis showed that there Was no relationship between student knowledge and food waste (p 0.108; r = -0.109). Discussion: Based on the Food Waste Behavior Model, student knowledge plays role as an initial cognitive factor; but food waste behavior is formed through the influence of habits and environmental context. Taste preferences, food quality and appearance; social influences; family eating habits, and portion and menu presentation determine the practice of leaving food. This shows that knowledge alone is not enough to change behavior; so reducing food waste requires improving menu quality, adjusting portions; and establishing a culture of respecting food in schools. Metode: Penelitian ini menggunakan Desain korelasional dengan pendekatan cross-sectional. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 220 responden dari total populasi 360 siswa kelas XI yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Variabel independen adalah pengetahuan siswa tentang Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) sedangkan variabel dependen adalah sisa makanan (food waste). Instrumen yang digunakan berupa kuesioner pengetahuan tentang MBG dan kuesioner sisa makanan (food waste) Analisis data dilakukan secara univariat dan bivariat untuk menganalisis hubungan antara pengetahuan siswa dan kejadian food waste. Hasil: Analisis yang dilakukan  menunjukkan hasil tidak  ada hubungan antara pengetahuan siswa dengan sisa makanan (food waste) (p = 0,108;r = -0,109. Pembahasan: Berdasarkan Food waste Behavior Model,  pengetahuan siswa berperan sebagai faktor kognitif awal; namun perilaku food waste terbentuk melalui pengaruh kebiasaan dan konteks lingkungan. Preferensi rasa, kualitas dan tampilan makanan; pengaruh sosial kebiasaan makan keluarga; serta porsi dan penyajian menu lebih menentukan praktik menyisakan makanan. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa pengetahuan  saja belum cukup mengubah perilaku; sehingga pengurangan food waste memerlukan perbaikan kualitas menu; penyesuaian serta pembentukan budaya menghargai makanan di sekolah. Kata kunci:   Pengetahuan Gizi, Makan   Bergizi   Gratis   (MBG), Food Waste, Perilaku Konsumsi, Siswa SMA xii SKRIPSI HUBUNGAN PENGETAHUAN SISWA ADE CAPRI S.S porsi, IR PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRACT THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN STUDENTS' KNOWLEDGE ABOUT FREE NUTRITIONAL MEALS (MBG) AND FOOD WASTE IN PUBLIC SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL 3 PAMEKASAN Cross-Sectional Research Ade Capri Surya Saputra Faculty 0f Nursing, Airlangga University adecapri surya-2022@fkpunairac id Introduction: Food waste in schools is an environmental  health problem that impacts   sanitation; the efficiency of nutrition   programs, as well as waste of resources and has the potential to become a medium for the development of disease vectors; s0 that it can hinder the effectiveness of the Free Nutritional Meal Program (MBG) in improving the nutritional status, health, and concentration of students" learning,  therefore this study aims to analyze the relationship between students ~ knowledge about the objectives of MBG, balanced nutrition; and the impact of food waste with the incidence of food waste in schools. Method: This study used correlational   design with cross-sectional   approach. The research amounted to 220 respondents from a total population of 360 grade XI students selected   using purposive   sampling   technique. The   independent   variable is students' knowledge about the Free Nutritional Meal Program (MBG), while the dependent   variable is food waste. The instruments used were knowledge questionnaire about MBG and food waste questionnaire. Data analysis was carried out   univariately   and   bivariately to analyze  the relationship between students' knowledge and the incidence of food waste. Results: The analysis showed that there Was no relationship between student knowledge and food waste (p 0.108; r = -0.109). Discussion: Based on the Food Waste Behavior Model, student knowledge plays role as an initial cognitive factor; but food waste behavior is formed through the influence of habits and environmental context. Taste preferences, food quality and appearance; social influences; family eating habits, and portion and menu presentation determine the practice of leaving food. This shows that knowledge alone is not enough to change behavior; so reducing food waste requires improving menu quality, adjusting portions; and establishing a culture of respecting food in schools. Pravelensi penggunaan tembakau di Indonesia masih relatif tinggi di kalangan remaja. Banyak remaja ingin berhenti merokok tetapi sulit untuk berhenti merokok karena tidak memiliki niat dan motivasi yang besar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis terkait prediktor niat untuk berhenti merokok pada remaja di Indonesia. Metode: Penelitian ini merupakan penelitian sumber data sekunder dari Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS) Indonesia tahun 2019 dengan desain cross-sectional. Sebanyak 1.191 remaja   dipilih menggunakan purposive sampling.  Identifikasi variabel  dan pengolahan data dalam penelitihan menggunakan aplikasi STATA Hasil: Penelitian ini menunjukkan hampir   seluruh remaja ingin berhenti merokok (81.619)- Kemampuan berhenti merokok [AOR-9.80, CI=6.12-15.73], persepsi merokok berbahaya bagi kesehatan [AOR=2.20, CI=1.40-3.48], sumber   dukungan [AOR-1.68, CI=1.02-2.50], status merokok teman [AOR-0.48, CI-0.38-0.74], menjadi   prediktor yang   berhubungan dengat niat remaja untuk berhenti merokok . Kesimpulan: Data Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS) Indonesia 2019 menunjukkan hasil dari total remaja yang merokok; sebagian besar remaja ingin berhenti merokok. ADITYA BUDI NUGROHO Ns., yaitu IR- PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRAK PENGALAMAN LANSIA MOMONG CUCU PADA ANAK BERKEBUTUHAN KHUSUS DI SLB KOTA SURABAYA PENELITIAN KUALITATIF FENOMENOLOGI Oleh: Aditya Budi Nugroho Pendahuluan Anak dengan kebutuhan khusus membutuhkan   perhatian  yang berbeda dari keluarga. Pada dasarnya anak yang berkelainan fisik, mental, maupun karakteristik perilaku sosialnya yang tidak sama seperti mendidik anak normal sehingga perlu strategi dan juga pendekatan khusus dalam merawatnya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk memperoleh pemahaman yang mendalam tentang pengalaman lansia momong cucu pada anak berkebutuhan khusus Metode Rancangan penelitian ini adalah   penelitian kualitatif   dengan   pendekatan  fenomenologi Sampel sejumlah 6 lansia yang momong cucu anak yang berkebutuhan khusus di SLB kota  surabaya dan didapatkan  dengan  menggunakan teknik   purposive sampling. Data diperoleh dari melakukan wawancara, voice recorder, alat tulis dan catatan lapangan (field note) kemudian dilakukan  analisis  data dengan metode colaizzi. Hasil Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa semua lansia merespon positif yaitu menerima yang berkaitan dengan keterlibatan momong cucu mereka. Kesimpulan setiap partisipan mengalami perasaan yang berbeda dalam mengasuh cucu anak berkebutuhan khusus dan partisipan lebih memilih mengasuh cucunya sendiri daripada diasuh oleh orang lain. Partisipan mengungkapkan respon yang sama berkaitan dengan arti cucu cucu adalah segalanya; melebihi anak sendiri, sebuah berlian; sebuah anugerah dan suatu kebanggaan Kata kunci: lansia, pengalaman; momong cucu anak berkebutuhan khusus IX SKRIPSI PENGALAMAN LANSIA MOMONG CUCU PADA. Pengumpulan data menggunakan kuesioner- Data dianalisis   menggunakan uji Spearmen Rho dengan   signifikansi 0,05. Hasil: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan terdapat hubungan  yang signifikan antara pengetahuan   dan   sikap ibu dengan   tindakan pencegahan   mukositis oral pada ibu dengan anak leukemia yang   mendapatkan kemoterapi (p-0,000). AHMAD HISYAM A F sehingga IR PERPUSTAKAAN UNIVERSITAS AIRLANGGA ABSTRACT Factor Associated With Complementary Feeding Practices 6-23 Month Old Children In Indonesia By Ahmad Hisyam Al Faisal Introduction: Improper complementary feeding practice in children under two months old is an issue in developing countries; which raises the risk for malnutrition; sickness; and mortality. This study aimed to determine factors associated with complementary feeding practices children 6-23 months in Indonesia. Methods: This study used the Indonesian Demographic and Health Survey 2017. The survey was cross- sectional and used a multistage cluster sampling. A total of 4,883 mothers with children aged 6-23 months were extracted from the children's dataset. The correlation of predisposing, enabling, and reinforcing factors on complementary feeding practices were examined the multinomial logistic regression:  Results: The multivariate logistic regression showed that children 18-23 months old from wealthier households [AOR = 2.57], mother with higher education[AOR = 5.22], frequency of internet usage [AOR 1.35], and delivery assisted by professional [AOR 1.73], more likely to achieve minimum dietary  diversity. Similarly, children 18-23 months old [AOR 4.71], wealthier household status [AOR = 2.02], mother with higher education [AOR = 2.93], and   delivery assistance by   professional [AOR 1.78] were significantly associated with minimum acceptable diet. Finally, children with working mothers [AOR = 1.21] and living in urban neighborhoods [AOR = 1.31] more likely to achieve minimum meal frequency . Discussion: Overall coverage of minimum dietary diversity and acceptable diet in Indonesia is still relatively low_ Age of children; household wealth status, mother' s education, and delivery assistance were associated with both minimum dietary diversity and acceptable diet.  Meanwhile, maternal occupation and residence were associated with minimum meal   frequency Improving   health care utilization; increasing the economic status and educational level of mothers is important to improve IYCF practices in Indonesia.
